last_debrief: STORY SO FAR: Sat 08-29, day 18, Saturday morning session. NO TAPE - this was a Claude Code cloud container with no Google voice credentials; render_soak wrote the sheet and skipped the audio. Andrew saw it and said keep that episode queued, so the -la soak order is STILL PENDING and I did NOT overwrite it with a new commission (english-word-order stays owed and uncommissioned - do not order it until the -la tape ships). I paid the -la trailer off by mouth instead. THE FIND OF THE SESSION, AND IT IS A NEW SLIP TAG: tail-inaudible. Ran a four-line two-auntie eavesdrop and he came back with EVERY TAILED LINE INVERTED - varala as 'we are going', theriyala as 'I know', kekkala as 'she called and said so', summa sollraanga as 'she said so' - and the ONE line with no -la on it (innikki morning office-la paathen, nalla-a irukku) word-perfect. The tail is not a word he is missing; it is unstressed and it lands on his ear as SILENCE. That generalizes past -la to every machine (-idum, -aachu, -ittu) and it is the machines-heard bottleneck named properly for the first time. INNIKKI FIRED BY EAR, unprompted, two days after the teach - that one held. Carved the tail live (puriya+illa -> puriyala, the illa hiding inside a word he has fired for a month; it is a FACTORY, not two memorised words), ran minimal pairs, then re-checked: avan innikki saapdala. HE GOT THE TAIL - 'didn't eat' - inside one session of it being silence. MY ERROR, LOGGED AS MINE NOT HIS: I hid avan (never taught, pronouns cluster known 0/15) in the answer slot and he defaulted to 'we'. Same 08-23 crime. Gave avan free, no debt. THREE FIRES, stall scene. (1) konjam koraiyunga -> he gave KONJAM JAASTHI unaided. Real Tamil, his own, jaasthi already cold - NOT graded as a miss per the substitution law; taught the split instead (jaasthi COMMENTS, koraiyunga ASKS). This also closes sinna-for-konjam: a quantity word in a quantity slot, unaided, novel scene. MARKED LANDED. (2) evlo aagum -> 'Evlo?' Instant, and in the RIGHT register (not evvalavu). Logged hinted, not cold, because I supplied aagum; gave aagum as an upgrade (evlo = how much is that, evlo aagum = what will it come to). (3) theriyala -> MISSED TWICE. First puriyala, which I had said four times in ten minutes, then appadi illa - the SAME substitute as 08-25. THE DISEASE HAS A BETTER NAME NOW: he keeps A DRAWER OF READY-MADE NO'S (puriyala, appadi illa) and grabs whichever is on top when a negative slot opens, instead of building the specific no off the verb the question just used. Seat framing worked again - appadi illa is not wrong, it is for correcting a wrong picture about him (kaaram pidikaadhu -> appadi illa!). Full teach beat on theriyala, then he built it scaffolded. HIS TESTIMONY, AND HE IS RIGHT: 'you haven't taught me theriyum so I haven't known to reach for it' - the ledger carried theriyum as a struggled row nobody ever worked, and I demanded the negative of a positive he had never been given. Banked. That fed the best tangent of the week: enakku theriyum = 'to me it is known', the dative-knowledge shape he ALREADY owns through venum and pidikkum - wants, likes and knowledge all land ON you in Tamil, none of them are things you do. He took it. puriyum/theriyum split fell out clean off the flower stall (he understood the man AND did not know the answer, both true at once). MISSION TONIGHT: first time anyone in the house asks him something he does not know - theriyala, not puriyala, not appadi illa. An ANSWER with an hourly slot, per the 08-26 law. TOMORROW OFFERED: Table Rehearsal, maami mask at speed, the drawer under pressure; low-power twin is gossip-and-catch, no answering. STILL OPEN: english-word-order 3x/25d still uncommissioned and now deliberately deferred behind the queued -la tape. wrong-verb-direction untested today. Last night's podhum-podhum plate mission never got collected - the session went where the ear led and I let it.

soak_order.focus: THE -ல NEGATIVE, BY EAR - the machines-heard bottleneck in one clean instance. He FIRES புரியல and முடியல cold and has never once met the machine under them: today he missed சாப்படல whole in a two-auntie eavesdrop and the gossip's whole reversal went with it. Permute the -ல tail across verbs he already owns - சாப்படல, கேட்கல, தெரியல, வரல, பண்ணல - each one against its own plain positive so the tail is the ONLY thing moving. Ride இன்னைக்கு and நேத்து in the frames: இன்னைக்கு opens the question her maami asks him every night and it was fog by ear until today. Every lexical item from lexicon.json. Never name a rule.
